purpose: Label-free, receipt-bound speech-feature preprocessing for the frozen 400-row Audio2Tool discovery split (roster A2T-CALIBRATION-400), the packet prerequisite of the direct-baseline calibration flight SAEA-A2T-DIRECT-CALIBRATION-V1 (preregistration docs/readiness/2026-09-03-a2t-direct-baseline-calibration-v1-preregistration.md, section 4 item 1). Two of the four calibration cells serve mmproj-free and therefore cannot encode audio themselves; every one of their requests needs an audited SpeechFeaturePacketV1. The launcher constructs samples only from receipt-pinned sample identifiers and media facts; it never loads task text, gold, expected tool calls, reference transcripts, annotations, outputs, scores, test data or future turns. A current-build CPU-only llama sidecar on port 8081 uses the fixed minimal one-token preprocessing prompt and the current-build legacy feature cache /home/chao/feat-cache/audio2tool-q4km-04ccc72a; the resident GPU decoder on port 8090 is never started, stopped, probed, reconfigured or contacted. After the sidecar stops, the carrier-neutral promotion primitive writes audited packets into the exclusive root /home/chao/feat-cache/a2t-calibration-400-packets-04ccc72a. Identity and preflight modes make no model, network, tokenizer, scorer or audio-decoding contact. This fragment grants no run or exposure authority.

a2t_calibration_preprocess_scope.d1_media_supplement: none, by design: all 400 sample ids are already inside the parent D1 identity closure and contracts.gate_media_identity refuses a supplement that duplicates a base D1 sample
a2t_calibration_preprocess_scope.packet_id_convention: sample_id with ':' replaced by '/' (tier1_direct:000045 -> tier1_direct/000045), the same convention every other Audio2Tool packet root uses
a2t_calibration_preprocess_scope.promotion_path: core.model.speech_features.materialize_legacy_cached_speech_feature_packets, called directly after the CPU-only encoder session stops; the carrier-specific SLURP command is not used and nothing under src/ is modified

a2t_calibration_preprocess_boundary.identity_inputs: roster receipt metadata and config fragments only
a2t_calibration_preprocess_boundary.preflight_inputs: receipt metadata plus filesystem path, size, SHA-256 and WAV container-header validation; speech content is not decoded or interpreted
a2t_calibration_preprocess_boundary.gpu_decoder: not started, stopped, reconfigured or contacted
a2t_calibration_preprocess_boundary.authority: none; running requires the separately registered exposure row SAEA-SN-A2T-CALIBRATION-400-PREPROCESS and its execution plan
